# Luma Dental Studio concept media

Stock images are illustrative; no model is represented as a patient, clinician or endorser.

Photography downloaded from Unsplash's image CDN under https://unsplash.com/license on 2026-11-11, resized and converted to WebP:

- clinic.webp: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1629909613654-28e377c37b09
- care.webp: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1606811971618-4486d14f3f99
- smile.webp: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1609840114035-3c981b782dfe
- portrait.webp: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1580489944761-15a19d654956

story.mp4: Artem Podrez, https://www.pexels.com/video/a-woman-smiling-at-the-camera-7957709/ under https://www.pexels.com/license/. Silent stock portrait, not a testimonial. Downloaded from https://videos.pexels.com/video-files/7957709/7957709-hd_720_1280_30fps.mp4

Before/after graphic: original CSS illustration, explicitly labelled simulation. Fictional cases, quotations and prices are labelled as examples throughout.

Design direction: user-requested Roveia-inspired scrolling, pill navigation and rounded cards, with original brand, layout implementation, assets and text. Section numbering and small secondary captions deliberately follow that reference. The decorative asterisk is the concept brand mark, not an emoji status indicator.
